coach_briefing: The recordings are strongly supported as one outing by close GPS-route overlap, despite unresolved approximately one-hour clock disagreement. Use SpeedCoach for the reviewed session values: 3915.3 m in 25:25.8 at 22.0 SPM. Do not blend mobile distances or SPM summaries: both mobile distance records conflict internally and neither raw mobile stream contains usable SPM. A brief SpeedCoach rise appears at 1260–1320 s (27.67 SPM; 3.145 m/s), but no plan supports calling it an interval or deviation. Plan compliance, boat/crew context, technique, physiology, and environmental effects remain unevaluated.
